I, 2</cite>) <he>ד׳ דברי וכ׳</he> the words of the scholars are related to the words of the Law; Cant. R. to l. c.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 35a:6">Ab. Zar. 35ᵃ</cite> <he>דברי דודים</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דודיך</he>) the words of the friends (the scholars); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:4">Num. R. s. 14</cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37:1">Gen. R. s. 37</cite> <he>בני דוֹדֵיהֶן וכ׳</he> cousins (related nation).—

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 2:5">Ab. Zar. II, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 29b">29ᵇ</cite>) do you read <he>כי טובים דּוֹדֶיךָ מיין … דּוֹדַיִיךְ מיין</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. a. Cant. R. l. c.) better is thy (God’s) love, or thy (Israel’s) love?
